# exocalib-init
Stage A, run once: metric, gravity-aligned exo cameras from one synchronized frameset of the exo videos. The refine graph starts from this rig.

**Read the picture top to bottom.** A box is one step: its number and name, what it does, how it runs (blue = source, orange = once per item, purple = once on the whole segment, green = output; while a run is live: grey = no input yet, green = ok, yellow = its queue is half full, red = it dropped items). A label on a line is the data that flows, `port: Type`, and how it arrives:
- **waits**: every item, in order; the sender waits while the queue is full (nothing is lost)
- **latest**: the newest value at or before the step's time; it never starts the step
- **drops old**: only the newest items; older ones are dropped while the step is busy

`(GPU)` after a type: the value stays on the GPU. A tag left of a box lists its inputs from further up (`port: Type ← 1 video · latest`). Box numbers match the sections below.

## 1 · video: Decode the cameras' videos
*source* · `VideoSource` · `packages/simplecv/simplecv/sources/catalog_video.py`

The STATIC values of ``statics`` first, then RGB framesets at sampled frames of the first camera inside ``window_ns``, timed by it (``Fenced[MultiViewFrames]`` when ``fenced``, else ``MultiViewFrames``). Each frameset holds every camera's frame nearest in time to the first camera's: cameras whose frames share timestamps pair index with index, cameras on one clock that start apart (SelfCap's phones) pair what happened at the same time, and a first-camera frame joins only when every camera has a frame within half its frame interval. ``resize_hw`` applies area resize; ``keep_native`` keeps the stored-size decode in the same value (``native``). ``catalog`` reads a catalog segment's videos and rig.

| gives | type | to |
|---|---|---|
| **frames** | `MultiViewFrames` (GPU) | 2 init |
| **rig** | `RigCameras` | nobody (unused) |

## 2 · init: Calibrate the rig from one frameset
*runs once per item* · `InitNode` · `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/nodes/init.py`

Stage A: metric, gravity-aligned exo cameras from one synchronized frameset (G3T + MoGe-2 scale + RANSAC floor).

| takes | type | from | arrives |
|---|---|---|---|
| **frames** | `MultiViewFrames` | 1 video | waits (4) |

| gives | type | to |
|---|---|---|
| **init** | `RigCameras` | 3 keep, 4 viewer, 5 exocalib_init |
| **metric_scale** | `MetricScale` | 4 viewer, 5 exocalib_init |

Uses the graph resources `g3t`, `moge` (built once, shared).

## 3 · keep: Hand values on to the App's next graph
*output* · `Latest` · `packages/dagkit/dagkit/sinks.py`

Keeps the newest value of each input in ``values`` (a multi-graph App builds its next graph from them, as exo-calib's refine passes from the Stage A rig); a stopped run hands on nothing.

Takes **init** from 2 init.

## 4 · viewer: Draw its inputs in the viewer
*output* · `RerunSink` · `packages/dagkit/dagkit/sinks.py`

Takes **init, metric_scale** from 2 init.

## 5 · exocalib_init: Save its inputs as a catalog layer
*output* · `LayerSink` · `packages/dagkit/dagkit/sinks.py`

Saves **init, metric_scale** from 2 init into the catalog layer `exocalib_init`.

## Data types
| type | what it is | code |
|---|---|---|
| `MetricScale` | Stage A's global metric scale: static ``AnyValues`` on the init rig entity | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `MultiViewFrames` | One synchronized sample of every camera; a single camera is ``v == 1`` | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/frames.py` |
| `RigCameras` | Per camera, in ``names`` order: pinhole intrinsics, world-to-camera pose (RDF, metric) and image size | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/rig.py` |

# exocalib-refine-pass1
Stages B-F, run twice: 2D keypoints tracked through the rig in every view, then bundle adjustment of the Stage A rig on them; the second pass tracks through the first pass's rig, fits the person's SMPL-X body through it and scores both rigs against GT.

**Read the picture top to bottom.** A box is one step: its number and name, what it does, how it runs (blue = source, orange = once per item, purple = once on the whole segment, green = output; while a run is live: grey = no input yet, green = ok, yellow = its queue is half full, red = it dropped items). A label on a line is the data that flows, `port: Type`, and how it arrives:

- **latest**: the newest value at or before the step's time; it never starts the step
- **drops old**: only the newest items; older ones are dropped while the step is busy

`(GPU)` after a type: the value stays on the GPU. A tag left of a box lists its inputs from further up (`port: Type ← 1 video · latest`). Box numbers match the sections below.

## Data types
| type | what it is | code |
|---|---|---|
| `BaseCalibration` | Refined cameras written onto base camera nodes that carry no dataset GT; the marker keeps them out of GT discovery | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `Keypoints3dTracks` | One frame of triangulated keypoints under both rigs (rows of ``xyz`` are ``VARIANTS``; NaN = not triangulated) | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `Kp2dOverlay` | One camera's Stage B drawing at that camera's own sample time: the person box (and its ``box_source``), the crop rectangle and the raw joints (``_raw``, grey, on every frame), plus (on the frames that carry ``gated_*``) the AssemblyHands-X-gated skeleton with the raw joints the gate rejected beside it; a frame without them clears the last ones | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `MultiViewFrames` | One synchronized sample of every camera; a single camera is ``v == 1`` | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/frames.py` |
| `MultiViewKeypoints` | Stage B record of one frameset: raw RTMW-x COCO-133 keypoints per camera with the box and crop they came from | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `RefinementDiagnostics` | What the refinement reports about its own run; static ``AnyValues`` on the refined rig entity, copied into ``eval.json`` | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `RigCameras` | Per camera, in ``names`` order: pinhole intrinsics, world-to-camera pose (RDF, metric) and image size | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/rig.py` |

## Data types
| type | what it is | code |
|---|---|---|
| `BaseCalibration` | Refined cameras written onto base camera nodes that carry no dataset GT; the marker keeps them out of GT discovery | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `BodyPose` | One frameset's fitted SMPL-X body in the refined (metric) rig's world: the axis-angle pose (smplx order: global, body, jaw, eyes, hands), the root translation and the mesh it gives | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `BodyShape` | The fitted SMPL-X body's shape for the whole segment (STATIC): its shape coefficients and the mesh's triangles | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `EvalReport` | ``eval.json``: per-variant GT metrics (``None`` without GT, written as null) and the GT-free diagnostics | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `Keypoints3dTracks` | One frame of triangulated keypoints under both rigs (rows of ``xyz`` are ``VARIANTS``; NaN = not triangulated) | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `Kp2dOverlay` | One camera's Stage B drawing at that camera's own sample time: the person box (and its ``box_source``), the crop rectangle and the raw joints (``_raw``, grey, on every frame), plus (on the frames that carry ``gated_*``) the AssemblyHands-X-gated skeleton with the raw joints the gate rejected beside it; a frame without them clears the last ones | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `MultiViewFrames` | One synchronized sample of every camera; a single camera is ``v == 1`` | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/frames.py` |
| `MultiViewKeypoints` | Stage B record of one frameset: raw RTMW-x COCO-133 keypoints per camera with the box and crop they came from | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `RefinementDiagnostics` | What the refinement reports about its own run; static ``AnyValues`` on the refined rig entity, copied into ``eval.json`` | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `ReportStatus` | Whether Stage E had GT for every exo camera (without it, nothing is scored or aligned): static ``AnyValues`` | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `RigAlignment` | SE(3) alignment of each rig variant onto GT (pred world -> GT world) and the aligned camera centres | `packages/exo-calib/exo_calib/types.py` |
| `RigCameras` | Per camera, in ``names`` order: pinhole intrinsics, world-to-camera pose (RDF, metric) and image size | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/rig.py` |
